evidence.quote: Atlas rollback rehearsals run monthly from now on.

A rollback

observations.why: Quinton issues an authoritative operational mandate ('run monthly from now on') while grounding it in shared collective capability and collective ownership ('we have not rehearsed', 'we do not actually have').
Records hierarchical task ownership and operational accountability assigned to a specific individual.
